title: The grade book
hints: Build it bottom-up: get `averageScore` and `gradeFor` right first, then `reportCard` can just call them. `honorRoll` is a `filter` and a `map` on top of `reportCard`.

averageScore: return 0 early for an empty list, sum with a `for...of` loop, then `Math.round(mean * 10) / 10`. gradeFor: an `if` chain from the highest band down, so each check only needs `>=`. curve: return a new object whose `scores` is `student.scores.map(...)` with `Math.min(100, s + points)`.
function honorRoll(students: Student[]): string[] { return students.map(reportCard).filter((card) => card.grade === "A").map((card) => card.name); }
